name: chatwoot-cf
description: Cloudflare-native Chatwoot - WhatsApp-first customer support platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter realtime dev" "pnpm --filter whatsapp-webhook dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter dashboard build && pnpm --filter widget-sdk build
scripts.deploy: pnpm deploy:api && pnpm deploy:realtime && pnpm deploy:webhook && pnpm deploy:dashboard
